description.value:
An oldie from Malorian Arms, based upon their classic Sub-Flechette Gun but scaled down for civilian use. The RE-45 specializes in one thing, and one thing only: dumping caseless flechettes as fast as possible to shred armor and flesh alike from point-blank range. It’s a favorite of tankers, pilots, and ACPA troopers that need to accurately dump an entire mag at arm’s length while defending their disabled or ammo-lacking mechanized apparatus of choice. It’s also quite the looker, given its age.

Cost: 1,750eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 18 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Auto-Compensator, Extended Magazine, Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear, Rubber Grip • Mods: None

Special Features: Armor-Piercing Ammunition bought for this weapon costs 50eb (Costly) per 10, and can only be used by this weapon. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear]. When firing this weapon at a target within 50m/yds, the total penalty (if any) applied to the Attack Check is reduced by 1 [Rubber Grip].

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Extended Magazine, Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear, Rubber Grip (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
